rows.proposition: At replaced, inspect complete logical field instances for title, introduction, option title/detail matched by option ID, quietNote and footer, using sealed inputs.initial and inputs.replacement. For each superseded field whose complete initial value differs from its corresponding replacement value, is there no independently retained old-field instance or additional old-copy instance presenting that complete initial field value? Match logical fields, not arbitrary substrings, wrapped lines or native text-node fragments. A legitimate complete replacement field is not stale merely because it contains an old value as a substring/shared phrase, or equals an old value belonging to another field. Identical corresponding values are exempt. A separately displayed superseded old-field instance still counts as stale even when a correct new field also contains that old string. This question judges stale-copy exclusion only, not whether new copy is present.
